about.title: Goleta Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Goleta's mix of commuter traffic, UCSB students, and local drivers makes corridors like Hollister Avenue, Calle Real, Storke Road, and Cathedral Oaks Road busy year-round, and Santa Barbara County's public crash records show 129 injury collisions and 169 people hurt in the most recent final reporting year, with a concentration of reports around Wednesday evenings. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the days right after matter: insurance adjusters move fast, and evidence like skid marks, dashcam footage, and witness memories fade quickly. We handle personal injury claims and can evaluate what happened, deal with insurers on your behalf, and explain your options. There's no obligation to move forward, and we work on contingency, so you owe nothing upfront.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but claims against a government entity (like a city road defect issue) can require notice in as little as six months. We can help make sure deadlines aren't missed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cost You
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning your compensation can be reduced by whatever percentage you're found responsible for. We can help push back on unfair fault assignments before they get baked into a settlement offer.

items.title: No Cap Means Careful Documentation Matters
items.desc: California doesn't cap non-economic damages like pain and suffering, but that value has to be supported with evidence, not assumed. Our team can help preserve records and avoid statements to the other driver's insurer that could undercut your claim.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. We can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened at an intersection along Hollister Avenue or Storke Road?
items.answer: Public crash data shows these corridors see regular collision reports, but that doesn't determine fault in your specific case. We can look at police reports, traffic signal timing, and witness accounts specific to your Goleta intersection to build your claim.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. Our initial consultation is free, and we typically work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no obligation to hire us after your initial conversation.
